_note: Recall eval for ADR-0003. Corpus = seeded past HVAC runs; queries point at the one 'gold' run a tech would want recalled. Several queries use words that DON'T appear literally in the gold run (coolant->refrigerant, AC unit->condenser) — those are where keyword recall fails and semantic recall should win. SAMPLE data.

corpus.transcript: replaced the dual run capacitor on the rooftop unit
topped up the refrigerant after finding a slow leak
condenser fan motor seized, installed a new one
cleared a clogged condensate drain line
annual maintenance, replaced the air filter and checked charge
thermostat reading wrong, installed a new programmable stat
blower motor was noisy, replaced bearings and belt
low on coolant, recovered and recharged the system
hard start kit added to a struggling compressor
evaporator coil frozen over, thawed and fixed airflow
replaced a failed start capacitor on the furnace
ductwork had a disconnected joint, resealed it
gas furnace igniter cracked, installed a new hot surface igniter
capacitor and contactor both replaced on an old AC unit
heat pump reversing valve stuck, replaced the valve
outdoor disconnect was corroded, replaced the whip and breaker
mini split indoor head leaking, cleared the drain and pump

queries.note: synonym: 'coolant' never appears literally — gold run says 'refrigerant'. keyword should miss.
synonym: 'fan motor' is 'condenser fan motor'; 'AC unit' not literal in gold.
semantic: 'charge'/'low' map to the refrigerant leak run, not literal.
